name: stypr
notes:
stypr.network (AS400671, part of AS-STYPR) is a multi-purpose Internet Service Provider(ISP) that provides secure and reliable automated network. There are plans to extend the network infrastructure for Anycast DNS and CDN support in the upcoming years.

BGP Large Communities are supported. Peers are encouraged to use them when importing, validating, or applying policy to routes received from our network.

The network infrastructure and dashboard systems are operated, maintained, and managed by stypr. Please note that the network is operated on a best-effort basis, and issue resolution may take up to 24 hours.

Sales emails sent to our mailbox are silently ignored. Please do not expect a response to sales-related inquiries.
